css:
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f5f7fb;color:#203653;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer} .page{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:32px 28px 64px}.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.logo{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:#237ac8;color:white;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:800}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#7d8da4;letter-spacing:1px}.top h1{margin:5px 0;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.6px}.badge{background:white;border:1px solid #e1e8f1;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:30px;color:#7c8da4;font-size:11px}.products{display:flex;gap:28px;border-bottom:1px solid #dde5ef;margin-top:26px}.products span{padding:12px 2px;color:#7d8da4}.products .active{color:#237ac8;border-bottom:2px solid #237ac8;font-weight:700}.nav{display:flex;gap:4px;background:#e9eef5;padding:4px;border-radius:10px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin:20px 0 28px}.nav span{padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;color:#6e8098}.nav .active{background:white;color:#237ac8;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #20365309}.heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:20px}.heading h2{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin:0 0 8px}.muted{color:#7c8da4;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}.period{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.period small{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:#7c8da4;font-weight:400}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}.stat{background:white;border:1px solid #e3eaf2;border-radius:13px;padding:18px 20px}.stat label{font-size:11px;color:#7c8da4}.stat strong{display:block;font-size:27px;margin:8px 0 5px;letter-spacing:-.8px}.stat small{font-size:11px;color:#8c9aad}.stat:first-child strong{color:#237ac8}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3eaf2;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden}.chart-head{padding:20px 24px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:center}.chart-head strong{font-size:14px}.legend{font-size:11px;color:#8190a3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.legend i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#237ac8}.chart-wrap{position:relative;padding-top:4px}#chart{height:365px;width:100%}.help{padding:0 24px 19px;color:#8493a8;font-size:11px}.detail{margin-top:18px}.detail-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:21px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f6}.detail-title{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.type-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px}.detail h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:15px}.detail-meta{font-size:11px;color:#8292a8}.detail-total{font-weight:800;font-size:22px}.detail-total small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:#8493a8;margin-left:4px}.table-head,.person{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1.5fr) 1fr 100px;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:15px 24px}.table-head{font-size:10px;color:#8b99ad;padding-bottom:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}.person{border-top:1px solid #f0f3f7}.identity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}.avatar{width:32px;height:32px;background:#edf3fa;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;color:#6b829e}.name{font-weight:650;font-size:12px}.count{font-size:12px;color:#6d7f98}.score{text-align:right;font-size:12px;font-weight:750}.bar{width:100%;height:4px;border-radius:9px;background:#edf1f7;margin-top:7px}.bar i{display:block;height:4px;border-radius:9px}.right{text-align:right}.empty{padding:28px 24px;color:#8292a8;font-size:12px}.week-access{padding:0 24px 15px;display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}.week-access button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#7c8da4;font-size:11px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:5px}.week-access button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#edf5ff;color:#237ac8}.foot{margin-top:18px;color:#94a1b3;font-size:10px}.chart-error{padding:30px;color:#bc2d0d}
@media(max-width:700px){.page{padding:20px 14px 40px}.top h1{font-size:20px}.badge{font-size:9px}.nav{width:100%;gap:0}.nav span{font-size:10px;padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;flex:1}.heading{flex-direction:column}.period{text-align:left}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.stat{padding:12px 16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center}.stat strong{font-size:23px;margin:0;grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3}.stat small{margin-top:4px}.chart-head{padding:18px 14px 0;align-items:flex-start}.legend{font-size:10px}.chart-head strong{font-size:12px}#chart{height:355px}.help{padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px;line-height:1.6}.detail-head{padding:17px 14px}.table-head,.person{padding:13px 14px;grid-template-columns:minmax(115px,1fr) 70px 65px;gap:8px}.name,.count,.score{font-size:11px}.avatar{width:27px;height:27px}.identity{gap:7px}.detail-total{font-size:19px}.detail h3{font-size:13px}.products{gap:24px}.week-access{padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px}}
